findings.note: The req() helper in tests/canon_fail_on_flag.rs:72-76 sets only current_dir and never calls env_remove("REQ_ROOT"), which other CLI tests (tests/init.rs, adopt.rs, cli_version.rs) do, so an exported REQ_ROOT redirects every run to a foreign corpus.

Correct: with args such as ['--fail-on-flag','x'] the guarded arm fails and Some(other) prints 'unrecognized flag: --fail-on-flag' (src/main.rs:520-535); exit 2 is still right, so only the message is misleading.
The exit line says 'it never gates' and then qualifies the --fail-on-flag case in the same sentence; awkward wording, but the opt-in is described right there, so it does not mislead about behaviour.
